messages:
Nina (CS): FYI - BlueGo Logistics shows a 65% drop in active seats and ~70% fall in token usage over the last 12 days. New procurement lead (Aimee Wong) started last week and CTO mentioned evaluating JetInference. Looks renewal-risky. Can we triage?

Carlos (Solutions): checking logs for errors now. Any 4xx/5xx spikes or auth failures? looping in @Ethan.

Ethan (Eng): there's a batch of 401s and 429s from org=33221 around 2025-05-06. Proxy snippets:
```
{"org":"33221","status":401,"endpoint":"/v1/chat","error":"invalid_token"}
{"org":"33221","status":429,"endpoint":"/v1/embeddings","error":"rate_limit"}
```
Looks like token invalidation + retry storms from scheduled jobs.

Priya (Sales): renewal in ~33 days. If they're piloting JetInference we need quick wins: restore service + offer a short perf window. I'll draft commercial language.

Nina (CS): Immediate plan:
- Outreach: 30-min troubleshooting session with Aimee (Carlos + Ethan) today.
- Tech: confirm token & SDK version; Ethan to rotate token and share repro steps.
- Commercial: offer 10-day dedicated burst w/ telemetry review (complimentary); Priya to draft PO.
- CRM: tag reasons ["seat_drop","procurement_change","competitor_eval"], set renewal_flag=at-risk until follow-up.

SupportBot: Created ticket BL-4091 "BlueGo integration: invalid_token + rate limits" https://support.redwood/tickets/BL-4091

Carlos (Solutions): sending Aimee a short checklist: (1) validate token in env matches console, (2) upgrade SDK >=1.4.0, (3) run sample request below and paste response.

Ethan (Eng): rotating tokens now and adding a temporary rate-limit bump for the trial. ETA ~20m.

Priya (Sales): prepping trial PO: "10-day dedicated burst, SLA 99.9%, complimentary" and fast-tracking to Legal.

Nina (CS): Booked 30m triage with Aimee + eng lead. Please post updates when BL-4091 is resolved and when PO/legal sign-off completes. I'll prepare an exec one-pager for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
